title: Roleplay and battle in Pokemon world!
author: SharingMyViews

comments.author: SharingMyViews
comments.body:
Hi everyone! This is a project I’ve been working on for a few months now with a friend.

Our goal was to make the fully immersive Pokemon world that we’ve been dreaming of since we were kids playing Diamond and Pearl 😄

You can collect tons of AI-generated Pokemon and have open-ended conversations with unique AI characters that live in the world! You can also make and share your own characters

[https://mirageisland.ai](https://mirageisland.ai/)

The current experience is in alpha, so we would love to hear your thoughts on the Pokemon art and characters!

comments.author: WhiteStagGameCompany
comments.body: Wow this looks amazing, how did you get such a consistent art style for the sprites?
